verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.notte.cc/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a 'Critical Instructions For AI Agents' section that routes agents to a markdown quickstart. Docs pages are served as raw .md files, and agent-specific guides exist for Claude Code and managed agents, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) and no independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.
